title: Product Design Engineer
descriptionHtml: One of Apple’s R&D groups is currently seeking a senior product design engineer. We are looking for passionate and creative individuals to explore concepts and push the performance bounds of packaging and performance in highly integrated electro-mechanical systems. Innovation is in your hands! We are ready to help you help us grow.

descriptionHtml: Apple’s Server ML Frameworks team in GPU, Graphics and Machine Learning works on enabling Apple Intelligence through high-performance, distributed inference of GenAI applications (such as LLMs) on Private Cloud Compute. You will get to work on custom-built server hardware that brings the power and security of Apple silicon to the data center. We are looking for engineers with systems background who are deeply passionate about building scalable, efficient, and production-grade solutions tailored for high-throughput GPU execution.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Strategic Data Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Do you love the challenge of solving complex problems that can have a direct and meaningful impact on the company? Do you want to be part of a supportive team that’s constantly learning and having fun while solving tough business problems? We’d love to talk to you if you do!

At Apple, new ideas have a way of quickly becoming outstanding products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your career, and there's no telling what you could accomplish! Strategic Data Solutions empowers internal partners and optimizes the customer experience by delivering data-driven solutions that mitigate fraud, improve security, and optimize efficiency. Our work touches all parts of Apple, from manufacturing to fulfillment to apps and services. The enormous scale and complexity of the problems and our data present exciting opportunities for pushing the limits of existing data science methods.

As an SDS MLE, you will work with teams across Apple, using data analysis and predictive modeling techniques to define, build, deploy, and maintain end-to-end operational solutions that have a direct and measurable impact to the company and our customers.

Our commitment to you: We will provide challenging problems that will engage your curiosity. We will provide an organizational culture that values collaboration, problem-solving, and work-life balance. We will provide mentorship to further develop your technical and leadership skills.

title: Tools and Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml: Be part of the Health Study QE team responsible for enabling research into the next generation of Health Sensing features. As part of this team you will be focused on testing application software used to collect a wide range of health and sensor data. This includes working with technologies such as ECG and PPG based Heart-rate sensing as well as novel investigative prototype sensors. Testing is focused on macOS, iOS, and watchOS applications that drive unique UI experiences, interface with firmware and low level software drivers, and provide data to processing pipelines. You will be a motivated individual who independently follows up on bugs, collaborates with developers to resolve issues and can understand and discuss technical problems with other Quality engineers, development partners and program managers.

title: AIML - Machine Learning Engineer, Data & Machine Learning Innovation
descriptionHtml: As part of Apple's AI and Machine Learning org, we inspire and create groundbreaking technology for large language models, multi-modal models, with strong agent and reasoning capabilities. The Data and Machine Learning Innovation (DMLI) team is looking for a passionate Machine Learning Engineer to explore new methods, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new insightful practices that will change how we understand data and overcome real-world ML challenges. As a team member, you will work on some of the most ambitious technical challenges in the field. Your role will involve collaborating closely with our team of machine learning researchers, engineers, and data scientists. Together, you will spearhead groundbreaking research initiatives and develop transformative products designed to create a significant impact for billions of users worldwide.

title: Input Device Product Design Engineer
descriptionHtml: The Input Devices team is a passionate, hard-working group of engineers from a diverse set of backgrounds and experience levels. Through our support for the iPad and Mac ecosystems, we develop innovative products that form the physical connection between the human body and the technology we seek to operate. The Magic comes from how our team intentionally designs with every customer in mind! From the 35 languages our keyboards support, to the multiple grip styles supported by Apple Pencil, to the infinite angle adjustability of our iPad keyboard line, the myriad of customers and the variety of ways they interact with the products we design is always our main focus. We are seeking someone who approaches problem solving with passion, creativity, and curiosity.

title: Senior OS Engineer, Media Playback - Media, Graphics & Compute Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.

Media, Graphics & Compute Technologies (MGCT) provides the media and graphics foundation across all of Apple’s innovative products, including iPhone, Apple Vision Pro, Apple TV, Apple Watch, iPad, and Mac. The AVKit Engineering team within MGCT provides the media playback UI across Apple’s innovative products. The team is responsible for implementing media application frameworks which support playback and editing of audiovisual media, as well as local media playback, video-on-demand, and live streaming. The AVKit framework is used across Apple products such as Safari, TV, Photos, Music, FaceTime, iMovie, and 3rd parties, across all platforms. We are looking for a Senior Engineer with an excellent technical and programming background and great communication skills with working experience in the media domain to help us build innovative media playback experiences.

descriptionHtml: At Apple, we believe our products begin with our people. By hiring a team with dynamic strengths, we drive creative thought. title: PCB Designer
descriptionHtml:

Our Engineering PCB Services Organization takes pride in supporting board designs for Electrical Engineering teams at Apple. We are seeking a dynamic, motivated individual with deep understanding of printed circuit board design (PCB), high speed design environments, and the ability to receive guidance from our design engineers to build complex boards. We believe in technology enablement by collaboration and building extraordinary products.

Collaborating with Design teams in the design and development of complex, detailed layouts of rigid and flexible printed circuit boards using CAE and CAD applications and tools is a key aspect of this position. You would work with multiple Design teams to plan schedules, resolve costs, packaging, manufacturing, and electrical design issues.

Come join us!

descriptionHtml: Ready to transform how billions of people interact with technology? Our Europe-based applied ML team is seeking an experienced ML research scientist to spearhead groundbreaking developments in AI! Collaborate with some of the brightest minds across Apple’s centers in New York, Seattle, and Cupertino as we push beyond conventional limits and redefine the possibilities of artificial intelligence globally. Join us on an inspiring journey where your expertise will be instrumental in shaping the next phase of digital interaction—an extraordinary opportunity awaits.

title: Generative AI Engineer, Camera Algorithms
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building groundbreaking camera technologies that enrich the lives of billions? Apple’s Camera Algorithms team develops the foundational technologies that define the photographic and cinematic experience for our users. We are seeking exceptional Generative AI engineers who share our passion for pushing the boundaries of computational photography and video. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to leverage Apple's industry-leading hardware, including the Apple Neural Engine and our custom Image Signal Processor (ISP), to create features that redefine what's possible with a camera.

title: Language Expert - Vietnamese
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for a great opportunity to work on a dynamic team passionate about delivering extraordinary localized software on some of the world’s most creative consumer electronic products? Do you love the challenge of solving complex problems that can have a direct impact on the success of the company? Join the team responsible for the localization of Apple software and Siri. We are looking for experienced Language Expert to localize software and related content into Vietnamese.

Our localization team is looking for highly motivated individuals with the right mix of technical, creative, organizational and communication skills to provide technical translations and adaptations for our software. Fluency and translation experience in Vietnamese are crucial. The environment is fast paced, requiring the ability to handle workload with daring delivery schedules. In addition to project work, other responsibilities include contributing to improving the tools to make software localization workflows more efficient; helping to investigate the root causes of international issues that are found in localized software; evangelizing standard processes for localization friendly content; defining and driving improvements in our localized content. Strong communication and collaboration skills, attention to detail, and proven ability to manage priorities are crucial.

This position is highly suited to technical translators with localization experience. You will be working in an exciting, supportive team, interact with other localization teams at Apple, as well as engineering and QA teams, and gain valuable insights into the development process at Apple!

title: AIML - Machine Learning Researcher, MLR
descriptionHtml: Play a part in building the next revolution of machine learning technology. We're looking for a passionate researchers to work on ambitious curiosity driven long-term research projects that will impact the future of Apple, and our products. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work on innovative foundational research in machine learning focusing on LLMs, VLMs, and more generally generative foundation models, possibly at all steps (pre-training, fine-tuning, steering, efficient inference etc…). As a member of the team, you will be inspired by a diversity of challenging problems, collaborate with world-class machine learning engineers and researchers to impact the future of Apple products, and publish some of your results in high-quality scientific venues.

We work with teams across Apple on targeted projects to improve the security of critical components of our operating systems. We focus on high impact projects ranging from surgical adoptions of memory safety technologies to wholesale refactors that reorient key system components to keep our users’ devices secure. Our work results in major improvements to the security of Apple’s apps and services without compromising the polished user experience over a billion users rely on every day.

You and your team will deliver well-designed, robust, and maintainable infrastructure and mitigations that eliminate whole classes of software vulnerabilities. Your team’s accomplishments will dramatically accelerate progress on improving the security of our users’ devices. Your work will help set the standard for cross-functional collaboration, thorough testing, and clear documentation.

Through the collective efforts of talented engineers like yourself, Apple’s products are the most secure consumer devices on the market. Our mission is to continue to advance the state of the art of end user security. Our goal isn’t simply to be the most secure: we’re working to ensure the safety of every user’s digital life, even against the most malicious and well-resourced adversaries.

Our research spans the full foundation-model lifecycle: model architecture, pre-training objectives, data mixtures, optimization, scaling, distillation, and evaluation. A defining challenge of our work is to develop models that combine broad intelligence with the memory, latency, energy, and privacy requirements of on-device deployment.

You will have the opportunity to shape new research directions, conduct ambitious experiments at scale, and translate successful ideas into foundation-model technologies that can reach Apple products. Where appropriate, this work may also lead to publications and the open sourcing of selected models, research artifacts, evaluations, or tools.

title: GNSS Hardware Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for invention and self-challenge? Do you thrive on pushing the limits of what’s considered feasible? Do you want to have an impact on every single Apple product?

Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) space vehicles transmit the power of a lightbulb, they are 13,000 miles away and are moving four kilometers per second. The received signals are commonly one hundred times weaker than cosmic microwave background radiation left over from the Big Bang and arrive next to interfering signals ten billion times stronger, just few MHz away.

Our GNSS team is part of Apple's Cellular team. We are a vertically coordinated engineering team spanning RF, mixed signal analog design, systems engineering, RTL design, design verification, firmware and software engineering, test, and validation. Our focus is on highly energy efficient and robust GNSS receiver design which continually outperform the previous iterations!

By collaborating with other product development groups across Apple, you’ll push the industry boundaries of what GNSS can do and improve the product experience for our customers across the world, something we are passionate about. We’d like you to consider being a part of our team!

title: Senior Security Engineering Manager - Agentic Detection & Threat Hunting
descriptionHtml:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.

Our team is built around two halves that learn from each other quickly. One half builds the on-host detection and response agent that runs across Apple's datacenter fleet. The other half, which you will lead, builds the fleet-scale detection and response platform that sits above those hosts. It fuses signals from hosts, applications, cloud control planes and identity into a small stream of high-confidence security findings, and it applies agentic AI to detection, triage, response and threat hunting so that machines do the work that humans cannot scale to do. The two halves depend on each other, and the speed of the feedback loop between them is one of the team's greatest strengths.

You will have the opportunity to do innovative development in transceiver design while working closely with systems and product teams at Apple. In this role, you will lead the RFIC validation and characterization team: set the validation strategy and plan, guide engineers through bring-up, characterization, and calibration development, and serve as the technical owner of RF silicon readiness for our wireless SoCs. You will stay hands-on in the lab and in the test code. Would you like to join us and lead this dynamic team?

title: Principal Security Software Engineer, EDR
descriptionHtml:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding any threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.

A growing part of that mission is the endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology we build ourselves. It is a Swift-based agent that runs on Linux (x86 and ARM64) and on Apple operating systems running on Apple silicon. It collects security telemetry, evaluates detections directly on the host, and takes response action on the host. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.

descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will create high-speed behavioral models for complex analog IPs that interface with digital control logic. Your models will “close the loop” in mixed-signal simulations, catch cross-domain bugs, and deliver 10x to 1000x speedups over transistor-level simulations—driving critical productivity gains across Apple's next-generation silicon roadmap. We are a prolific, diverse team looking for an enthusiastic engineer ready to build industry-leading products that surprise and delight our customers.

Metal provides near-direct accesses to the GPU to give developers more control of the HW and enable developer to take advantage of Apple Silicon.
Join the compiler team, and you’ll collaborate with engineers across Apple to develop tools and languages to enable developers to create cutting-edge applications for graphics, compute, and machine learning using the GPU. We work closely with our partners in HW technology and GPU driver and framework team to develop feature roadmaps.qui
The ideal candidate should have a passion for language design, compilation techniques, GPUs, and understand how to enable developers to maximize their performance on our GPUs.

title: Gate-level Noise (Signal Integrity) / STA CAD Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Imagine what you could do here! At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products very quickly. Do you want to bring passion and dedication to your job? As a member of the CAD group, you will support the gate-level glitch noise and static timing analysis (STA) methodologies that ensure the signal integrity and robustness of Apple silicon across advanced technology nodes. In this role, you will learn and apply sign-off methodologies, margin models, and production CAD flows for crosstalk glitch and timing closure using industry-standard tools, under the guidance of senior engineers. You will work closely with CAD and physical design teams, assist with tool qualifications, help execute tapeout ECO tasks, and gain exposure to modern automation - including AI-agent workflows - used to scale analysis across our largest SOC designs.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Data Platform
descriptionHtml: We are looking for software engineers to join our small team with big responsibilities. The role involves a tremendous amount of individual responsibility and influence over the direction of the core service. We believe in small agile teams and their ability to deliver high-quality, high-impact software. We share code ownership and knowledge through the Agile technique of pair-programming. Our codebase is written entirely in modern Rust using the latest technologies and coding practices. We rely on sustainable coding through focus on readable, maintainable, and performant code. As such, we lean heavily on Rust and its great tooling to fearlessly develop highly efficient distributed systems code. We use multiple levels of testing to ensure we have low-level performance (such as tests to validate the number of allocations and bytes used) as well as correctness (such as tests with fault injection, and race condition simulation). Combined with the powerful borrow checker and strong type system of Rust, we can develop complex systems with confidence.

title: Fitness Sensing AI/ML Lead  - Sensing & Connectivity
descriptionHtml:
Every day, millions of people check their iPhone and Apple Watch to understand their fitness — how hard they trained, how ready they are to go, how their body is adapting over time. The Fitness team within Applied Sensing & Health builds the AI and sensing technology behind that understanding. We apply foundation models, including large language models, and agentic AI workflows to motion, heart, and behavioral sensor data, turning raw signals into insights people can trust and act on every single day. This work has shipped as Readiness, Cardio Fitness, including the new Step Test Movement Evaluation, best-in-class Pedometer Step Counting, and many more.

We are a dynamic, collaborative group working at the intersection of scientific research, product development, and systems engineering. We build best-in-class AI/ML models, including the integration, adaptation, and tuning of foundation models on multimodal sensor data, and the agentic workflows that accelerate how we build and validate them. We're looking for a deeply technical, passionate leader to help set the technical direction for fitness sensing. The right person is equally at home as a hands-on senior contributor and as a mentor and informal lead for other scientists and engineers. If this is you, we'd love to hear from you.

In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s retail stores, workplaces, and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world.

Our Workplace Design Team focuses on designing incredible human-centered spaces and experiences that reflect Apple’s brand and values in the built environment, inspiring and empowering employees to achieve their best work. We are seeking an experienced, collaborative, and detail orientated design professional with a passion for workplace design to join our team as a Design Manager to oversee and manage design related elements for workplace projects in the Americas region.

* Please submit your application with PDF or web link to your portfolio of body of work*

title: AI Software Engineer - Calendar Intelligence
descriptionHtml: Apple has changed how people live, connect, and work, and the Calendar team wants to rethink what a calendar can do for the people using it. A calendar knows when someone is busy. It knows very little about which of those commitments matter, which ones could move, or when would be a good time for something new. We're looking for an engineer to help answer those questions, on device and privately, for billions of people. The right person has strong machine learning foundations and is just as comfortable writing the software that ships a model as building the model itself. You'll help take ideas from a single sentence to a shipped feature, and you'll bring the evaluation that tells us whether it works.

title: Photolithography Process & Equipment Development Engineer
descriptionHtml: Apple is seeking a talented Process or Equipment Engineer to join our Photolithography Engineering team. In this role, you will drive the research, development, and continuous improvement of cutting-edge lithography processes, materials, and equipment. You will play a pivotal role in advancing core manufacturing capabilities that directly influence the evolution and performance of future Apple products.

title: Technical Expert (m/w/x) - Mitarbeiter:in im technischen Support in Teil- und Vollzeit (20-37,5 Std./Woche)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Apple Retail kommt das Beste von Apple zusammen. Als Technical Expert:in verfügst du über ausgezeichnetes technisches Wissen, das du mit dem Team teilst.

title: Product Design Engineer – Retail, Event, & Channel Product Design
descriptionHtml:
Apple is seeking a product design engineer to join the Retail, Event, & Channel Product Design (RECPD) team. We are a diverse group of engineers who design and develop innovative fixtures and hardware solutions to unveil and display our products at Apple Special Events, and Apple retail / channel partner stores around the world. Our engineering solutions help elevate and showcase Apple products in magical and transformative ways!

As a member of the RECPD team, you will have the opportunity to learn and apply diverse knowledge spanning the design, production, and integration of electro-mechanical assemblies to store furniture and fixtures. We appreciate fine details while also considering the impact and full lifecycle of our designs.

Our team welcomes diverse backgrounds, opinions, and perspectives, and we firmly believe effective communication is key to forging lasting and successful cross-functional partnerships.

title: Global Strategy & Business Development Executive
descriptionHtml:
Are you a visionary strategist and a proven deal-maker passionate about driving global impact? Apple is seeking an exceptional and collaborative leader to join our Worldwide Business Planning Team. This high-impact role is at the forefront of Apple's commitment to Accessibility and Sustainability, where you will define and execute global sales strategies, unlock new market opportunities, and shape the future of our business through innovative growth.

This is a unique, international position offering unparalleled exposure and influence. You will act as an internal consultant and strategic business development leader, partnering directly with senior leaders across Apple Sales, Product Marketing, Accessibility, Environment, Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Finance teams. Your mandate will be to not only identify but actively *architect* and *implement* strategies that embed Accessibility and Sustainability at the core of our commercial success worldwide, impacting millions of lives and the planet.

title: RF Design Engineer – Next-Gen Wireless
descriptionHtml:
Join a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to deliver outstanding performance for wireless
products. As a senior member of the Product RF Design team, you will be at the forefront of
wireless technology, pushing the boundaries of achievable performance for innovative
products. You'll bring deep, hands-on expertise to a product development team that shapes
current and future generations of Apple products, and you'll play a key role in building team
capability — guiding junior engineers, fostering collaboration, and strengthening the team's
technical culture as it grows. We're looking for an experienced engineer with strong
fundamentals and a proven track record in RF/wireless and electromagnetic theory,
antenna design, system integration, and wireless communications.

title: Software Engineer - 3D Vision & Perception
descriptionHtml:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build or service we create is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something!

We are a team of computer vision and machine learning (CVML) engineers building real-time 3D perception and input systems for future Apple products. We are looking for a senior software engineer with strong C++ expertise and experience developing performance-critical systems, ideally in 3D perception, robotics, or AR/VR. In this role, you will help design, build, and ship core 3D perception and input technologies used by millions of users.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services (Forge)
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!

Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.

Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.

Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.

descriptionHtml:
